body:
Address security and observability findings from adversarial review round 25:

1. In sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs, restrict the permissions of .booster/token file to 0o600.
2. In lib/scheduler.mjs, handle undefined err.message in logs by using err.message ?? err or String(err) when logging failures.
3. Fix failing scheduler tests by adding AGB_ADLC_BIN: FAKE_ADLC to the failing test environments.
title: fix: restrict token file permissions and handle undefined err.message in logs
